executor_bootstrap_gates.requirement: Scientific stages cannot PASS with FRAMEWORK_ONLY, PLAN_ONLY or DRY_RUN output modes.
Resume validates every completed stage in order, including dependency receipt hashes and semantic input digests.
A retry creates a new attempt namespace; existing terminal receipts are never replaced.
SKIPPED is terminal-success only when the bound campaign contract explicitly declares the stage not applicable.
Interruption cannot create a false PASS; partial outputs remain partial and are revalidated on resume.
Semantic input changes invalidate downstream stage instances.
Each fallback class has a finite attempt budget and then BLOCKED.

stages.name: ASSET_AUTHORITY
actions: Verify exact revision and all required local asset hashes without network substitution.
Verify architecture/config identity against accepted Qwen3 static authority.
Bind authorization SHA into the campaign semantic input digest.

stages.name: ENVIRONMENT_PREFLIGHT
actions: Record GPU UUID/name/compute capability, driver, CUDA, Python, torch, transformers and profiler/tool identities.
Prove exact Qwen3 runtime class/API availability using the local hash-closed environment.
Check disk/free-space budget and writable staging paths.
Check process lock, GPU exclusivity policy and global formal-admission lock availability.
Select only the execution mode permitted by the final authorization.
pass_gates: capacity/storage preflight satisfied for the authorized mode
blocked_on: runtime dependency would require unapproved network/latest-package substitution
insufficient staging storage for bounded campaign

stages.name: INPUT_AUTHORITY
actions: Verify the exact Qwen3 S2 payload token-for-token against the final V2 authority.
Keep payload/file SHA and canonical token-sequence SHA as distinct typed fields.
Record batch/context/decode metadata and tokenizer authority.

stages.name: NATIVE_SMOKE
actions: If full-resident native mode is authorized, execute a bounded exact smoke under that mode.

If full-resident native mode is explicitly not applicable and exact streamed-layer mode is authorized, record policy-authorized SKIPPED for native smoke and execute a bounded streamed-execution smoke as evidence.
Do not silently change precision/backend/model.
pass_gates: authorized mode executes without semantic substitution
output is finite and runtime metadata is captured

stages.name: KERNEL_CENSUS
actions: Run bounded application execution with semantic NVTX/module ranges and profiler evidence sufficient to classify actual kernel implementations.
Produce kernel census by phase, semantic role/range, kernel signature, launch count, duration mass and shape where directly observable.
Classify implementation families before any formal target selection.
pass_gates: census complete for the authorized bounded S2 window
semantic range evidence and profiler artifacts hash-closed
no target inferred from launch order
blocked_on: semantic ranges cannot be correlated after bounded methods
profiler/runtime evidence incomplete for candidate classification

stages.name: SEMANTIC_TARGET_SELECTION
actions: Generate a mechanical candidate table from observed semantic roles and implementations.
Bind selected target IDs to exact layer/role/phase/decode step/shape/kernel implementation evidence.
Prefer the authorized lineage-continuity MLP anchor and optionally one materially distinct attention/KV target only when evidence supports it.
pass_gates: every selected target is losslessly semantically bound
candidate-table SHA and authorization SHA are bound
selected target count is within authorization
blocked_on: semantic binding ambiguous after bounded methods
authorization does not bind the observed candidate table

stages.name: SELECTIVE_STATE_CAPTURE
actions: Capture or reconstruct exact incoming hidden state, position/attention state, layer-local KV state, exact BF16 target-layer weights and any other directly required runtime state.
For streamed mode, run the exact model semantics through preceding layers/state transitions; do not synthesize hidden state.
Hash-close every captured tensor/state descriptor and execution identity.

stages.name: REPLAY_EQUIVALENCE
actions: Establish deterministic same-method repeatability before setting any non-bitwise tolerance.
Run dedicated semantic replay from the captured exact state.
Compare target outputs using bitwise equality when repeatability is bitwise; otherwise use a pre-frozen tolerance derived from same-method repeatability rather than post-hoc tuning.
pass_gates: replay output meets predeclared equivalence criterion
blocked_on: equivalence threshold cannot be justified independently

stages.name: IN_CONTEXT_SIGNATURE_GATE
actions: Compare scoped in-context and replay kernel signatures for the selected semantic target.
Method A uses the proven synchronized semantic-range/signature approach.
At most one bounded fallback may adjust the isolation mechanism without changing target semantics.
Do not accept output equivalence alone.
pass_gates: kernel implementation/signature equivalence proven for the formalized target path

stages.name: FRESH_STATIC_PATH_AUDIT
actions: Disassemble/audit the exact Qwen3 target implementation; never inherit Qwen2 static PCs/counts.
Enumerate direct GLOBAL MREF, LDGSTS GLOBAL_SOURCE and any other address-bearing path classes.
Treat LDGDEPBAR as control-only.
Build fresh static sets and prove complete executed/zero partition for every instrumented address path.
If an uninstrumented special address path appears, stop before formal capture.
pass_gates: executed plus zero-execution-proven equals complete static set

stages.name: FORMAL_CAPTURE
required_inputs: formal admission lock not yet needed for local capture
actions: Capture the selected target under the exact qualified replay/in-context mode with same-process address context.
Use deterministic shard identities and .partial-to-final publication.
Make shard-level capture resumable: completed hash-valid shards are not repeated after interruption.
Verify terminal records, static-PC membership, zero/nonzero path closure and drop/overflow counters.
Promote object roles only from direct same-process storage/range identity; otherwise UNKNOWN_RUNTIME.
pass_gates: all required shards complete and hash-valid

stages.name: FORMAL_ADMISSION_ACK
actions: Acquire the global formal-admission lock.
Verify catalog preconditions and admit exactly one target/run at a time.
Wait using the bounded existing ACK policy.
Release/advance only after an accepted ACK is hash-bound to the admitted run.
Do not start a second target admission while ACK is unresolved.
pass_gates: accepted Pipeline ACK present and hash-bound

stages.name: NCU_PROFILE
required_inputs: formal ACK for the corresponding target
actions: Collect bounded application-context NCU for the exact semantic target/qualified implementation.
At minimum preserve the accepted comparable traffic metric family when available: l1tex__t_bytes, lts__t_bytes, dram__bytes.
Export numeric values together with original metric names, units, cache-control/replay mode and report hashes.
Do not infer unit conversion or whole-model temporal behavior.
blocked_on: required metric semantics unavailable for intended comparison

stages.name: REVIEW_PACK_CLOSE
required_inputs: all required S2 target stages terminal
actions: Compute compact per-target memory fingerprints from formally accepted evidence without inventing chronology.
Record S3 as RUN, SKIPPED_BY_POLICY, NOT_MATERIALLY_INFORMATIVE, INFEASIBLE_UNDER_AUTHORIZED_MODE or BLOCKED with evidence.
If S3 is authorized and selected, execute it through a separate hash-bound scenario campaign using the same gates before final closure.
Run executable review-pack validators and negative tests.
Generate SHA256SUMS and final scoped scientific claims.
